exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Maps Do you think it’s better to use a paper map or a map on your phone? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Maps When was the last time you needed to use a map? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Maps If you visit a new city, do you always use a map to find your way around? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Maps In general, do you find it easy to read maps? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe an occasion when you had to do something in a hurry. You should say: what you had to do why you had to do this in a hurry how well you did this and explain how you felt about having to do this in a hurry.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Arriving late Do you think it’s OK to arrive late when meeting a friend?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Arriving late What should happen to people who arrive late for work?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Arriving late Can you suggest how people can make sure they don’t arrive late?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Managing study time Is it better to study for long periods or in shorter blocks of time?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Managing study time What are the likely effects of students not managing their study time well?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Managing study time How important is it for students to have enough leisure time?
